Class TerminalSession

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.TerminalSession
public class TerminalSession extends Object
The TerminalSession type is one SSH shell and one JediTerm canvas. The name SSH means the secure shell. The name JediTerm means the terminal widget that draws the shell. The frame keeps a tree of these sessions. The TerminalSession.Host type is the frame callback. The callback runs on the Swing event thread. The name Swing means the Java library that owns that thread. The disconnect clears the live connector. The disconnect sets the mood-told flag to false. The error path does the same clear. The stored mood line is not cleared by those paths. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#TerminalSession

  • Constructor Details

    • TerminalSession

      public TerminalSession(DarkJediTermSettings settings, SshClientTheme theme, TerminalSession.Host host)
      The constructor builds a disconnected session and wires the controller listener. The state starts as SshConnectionState.DISCONNECTED. The connecting callback stores that state, then runs TerminalSession.Host.sessionConnecting(TerminalSession) on the event thread. The connected callback stores the connector and SshConnectionState.CONNECTED, then runs TerminalSession.Host.sessionConnected(TerminalSession, SshTtyConnector, String, int). The disconnected callback clears the connector, sets the mood-told flag to false, stores SshConnectionState.DISCONNECTED, and runs TerminalSession.Host.sessionDisconnected(TerminalSession, SshTtyConnector, String). The error callback does that same clear and runs TerminalSession.Host.sessionError(TerminalSession, SshTtyConnector, String). The mood line is left as it was on both of those clears.
      Parameters:
      settings - The shared font and colors.
      theme - The dark painter for the thinking strip.
      host - The frame callback.

      public SshTtyConnector getLiveConnector()
      The getLiveConnector method returns the connector stored while the session is connected. The result is null before connect and after a disconnect or an error.
      Returns:

    • dispose

      public void dispose()
      The dispose method tears down the SSH connection and then the widget. The controller disconnects and the caller waits for that close. The panel then disposes the JediTerm widget.

    • hop

      private static void hop(Runnable task)
      The hop method runs a task on the Swing event dispatch thread. The method runs the task immediately when the caller is already on that thread. The method schedules the task with invokeLater on every other thread.
      Parameters:
      task - The work that must run on the event thread.
